findings.evidence: Then list every flag in the logged command with its value, one per line, and check each against the source: for a bug `--title`, `--description` ... `--priority`, and no flag the source does not support

Collapse the remaining flag audit into one rule: quote any logged flag whose value is not exactly the source text, instead of requiring one line per flag on every supplied-log review.

findings.evidence: 10 should-trigger queries all name qa-test-planner or /qa-test-planner; the 10 should-not-trigger queries include near-misses such as Draft a QA test plan with entry and exit criteria

Drop references/test_case_templates.md from the checkout-cases files list. It is a skill reference the routing table already loads, not an input; the same eval's assertions do not depend on that path.
